name: Cognia Plugin Template
description: Starter template for a Cognia WASM plugin — one agent tool and one workflow node, both answered from the sandbox. Generated by `cognia plugin new`.

tools.name: template_echo
tools.description: Echo the supplied message back to the agent. Replace with your own tool.

nodes.label: Template Echo
nodes.description: Echo its input downstream. Answered by `workflow-node-execute` in the sandbox.

permissionJustifications.notification: Says hello once on activation so you can see the plugin loaded.
permissionJustifications.secrets:read: Reads this plugin's own namespaced `api-token`, and degrades to a log line when it is absent or the grant is refused.
permissionJustifications.extension:workflow: Contributes the template workflow node to the visual workflow editor.
